title: MEDPI: EVALUATING AI SYSTEMS IN MEDICAL PATIENT-FACING INTERACTIONS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark, MEDPI, evaluates large language models in patient-clinician conversations across 105 dimensions related to medical process, treatment safety, outcomes, and doctor-patient communication.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
